verdict.rationale: The locations page documents Osborne Clarke's own offices across multiple countries (Germany, UK, Italy, Spain, US, Singapore, China) plus dedicated India relationship coverage and pan-European practice experience (e.g., UPC, cross-border data protection, multi-jurisdictional EC&VC support), directly supporting founder cross-border expansion without needing a second firm. Missing for 10: independent verification (e.g., legal directory rankings) confirming qualified practice status in each listed jurisdiction beyond the firm's own claims.
